item.title: Kaukauna wrestling wins sixth consecutive state championship
item.description: (WFRV) - In their 24th trip to team state wrestling, Kaukauna captures its sixth consecutive championship in division one. The Galloping Ghosts defeated Holmen 31-26 in the finals. Kaukauna's 14th straight state appearance ends in gold once again. In division two, Coleman finished as runner-ups and Weyauwega-Fremont's season ended in the division three state semifinals. [...]
